summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K reporting a public offering of 22,666,667 ordinary shares at $3.75 per share, plus a full exercise of the underwriters' option for an additional 3,400,000 shares, with gross proceeds of about $91.20 million. Separately, it entered into PIPE subscription agreements for 17,826,666 shares at the same price, raising approximately $66.85 million. The offerings are expected to close on June 17, 2026. This is a routine capital raise under an effective shelf registration statement, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing reflects ordinary financing activity.
